title: A Feasibility Study of a Wearable Arrhythmia Monitoring System (PulseON) in Stroke Patients
official: A Feasibility Study of a Wearable Arrhythmia Monitoring System (PulseON) in Stroke Patients
summary: To evaluate the usability of the Pulse ON wearable device in patients with cryptogenic stroke/TIA
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients (\>18yrs old) diagnosed with cryptogenic stroke / TIA
* Baseline electrocardiogram (ECG), Holter monitor and echocardiogram as part of the standard of care cardiac work-up in the diagnosis of cryptogenic stroke

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients unwilling or unable to wear the PulseON arrhythmia detection device.
* Known pre-existing AF or atrial arrhythmia diagnosis.
* Participants without capacity will be excluded from this study.
* Participants who are pregnant will be excluded from this study.
